purpose: third source-held-out confirmation of the development-only FMM arrival-residual gate

summary.gate_rule: accept FMM estimate only if arrival_rmse_s <= 0.09508478690085563

limitations: Synthetic source-held-out confirmation on the same Overthrust model and receiver geometry. The rule only accepts or abstains from FMM outputs; it cannot improve the underlying estimate. Observations share source waveforms across noise conditions and are clustered by source. The new residual candidate was selected after prior holdouts were reviewed, but its threshold uses development data only.
